FN-T7UK99-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 439
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/09/2023
House Bill 439 as introduced could reduce income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund and
financial institution excise tax, insurance premium tax, and state public utility license tax
receipts to the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of
Growing Alabama tax credits allocated from a parent or holding company to a subsidiary, as
provided by this bill, that would otherwise not be allowed to be transferred under current law.
Page 1

FN-T7UK99-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 439
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/10/2023
House Bill 439 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education could reduce
income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund and financial institution excise tax, insurance
premium tax, and state public utility license tax receipts to the State General Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent on the amount of Growing Alabama tax credits issued to a
parent or holding company but claimed by a subsidiary, as provided by this bill, that would
otherwise not be allowed to be transferred under current law.

FN-T7UK99-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 439
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/17/2023
House Bill 439 as passed the House of Representatives could reduce income tax receipts to the
Education Trust Fund and financial institution excise tax, insurance premium tax, and state
public utility license tax receipts to the State General Fund by an undetermined amount
dependent on the amount of Growing Alabama tax credits issued to a parent or holding
company but claimed by a subsidiary, for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2021, as
provided by this bill, that would otherwise not be allowed to be transferred under current law.
